final: WITH g AS (SELECT archstat, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanqc GROUP BY archstat), s AS (SELECT archstat, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g) SELECT archstat, cnt AS record_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS above_avg FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s)
